answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the dune until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the marble of the next round. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
